title: Illustration / Characters / Hair / Be careful
slide_intent: Control the connection between hair and facial color so small construction choices do not create an unintended appearance.
strategic_value: A sideburn check and a nose-color exception can help Duolingo keep faces clear without adding distracting detail.
demonstration: Two rows compare accepted and rejected faces: the upper pair changes hair above the ear, and the lower pair changes nose color with facial hair.
practical_value: Check the hair above the ear and make the nose match the skin when facial hair is present.

content_islands.name: Hairline comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the accepted face above left and its rejected counterpart in a crossed frame beside it, exposing the missing hair near the ear.

content_islands.name: Facial-color comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the second accepted/rejected pair below, comparing skin-colored and contrasting noses on a face with facial hair.

content_islands.name: Two cautions
content_islands.spec: Place the Be Careful heading and explanatory paragraphs at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that the hairline gap can resemble a bad haircut and that extra facial colors can create noisy or muddy features.
reference_purposes.Application: Two paired comparisons isolate the hairline and nose-color changes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source requires some hair above the ear/sideburn and a skin-colored nose when adding facial hair.

ingredient.name: Hairline and facial-hair color rules
ingredient.role: Prevent distracting gaps and color noise in the face.
ingredient.application: Include hair above the ear or sideburn; when facial hair is present, keep the nose the same color as the skin.
ingredient.scope: Historical official Duolingo illustration guidance from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot. The skin-colored nose condition applies when facial hair is added, alongside the separate profile-view rule elsewhere.
